title: Fun Facts with Francesca
text: We had a lot of fun with Francesca, who took her time to really highlight what makes these two iconic houses so special and so different. The early-ish start allowed us to miss the worst of the crowds, but she also deftly maneuvered us past those who had to pose for selfies at every turn. If seeing these stunning Gaudi creations wasn’t enough, the chocolate tasting exceeded our expectations: We left fulfilled, both literally and figuratively!
author: Johnny_P

title: Great tour!
text:
We saw two excellent Gaudi houses. They were even greater with all the interesting details provided by Xavi - the best guide we had so far. Between the two visits we had a great chocolate tasting - higly recomended.
The picking up from our hotel was another plus.
Great tour, even greater guide.
author: Dream29603037623

title: Small Customized Tour is the Way to Go
text: Experiencing a customized tour with a very small group made the experience much more enjoyable. Our guide was knowledgable and personable as well.
author: JuneH_J

title: We had the same tour...
text: We had the same tour guide as of the Casa Gaudi and again very knowledgeable and explain us the whole differences from one place to the other
author: Claudia_D

title: Wonderful Gaudi Experience
text: Seeing both Gaudi houses so different in many ways, a testament to his genius. Our guide Miguel was FABULOUS. highly recommend this experience although a little pricey. Don't miss this one!
